title: Yuna Anisaki Launches Kōkyū Gohi no Kuroshiro na Oshigoto Manga on September 18
content: Shogakukan 's Yawaraka Spirits manga website revealed last Friday that Yuna Anisaki will launch a new manga adapting Kazuki Karasawa 's Kōkyū Gohi no Kuroshiro na Oshigoto (The Black and White Duties of the Inner Palace's Lady of Go) novel. The manga will launch on September 18.
author: ANN

title: BookWalker Expands Catalog with Mahjong Pros Publishing Titles
content: Kadokawa 's BookWalker Global store announced on Tuesday that it is partnering with Mahjong set company Mahjong Pros ' Mahjong Pros Publishing imprint to expand its catalog with the publisher's titles.
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen, Kagurabachi, More Manga Rank on NYT September Bestseller List
content: The manga on this month's list include: • #7 — Gege Akutami's Jujutsu Kaisen volume 1 • #9 — Takeru Hokazono's Kagurabachi volume 8 • #15 — Mokumokuren's The Summer Hikaru Died volume 1 The first volume of Jujutsu Kaisen ranked at #7 in August.
author: ANN

title: Goodbye, Lara Anime Gets Manga
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kinema Citrus ' Goodbye, Lara ( Sayonara Lara ) original anime announced on Tuesday that the series will get a manga adaptation by Citrus creator Saburouta on Kadokawa 's KadoComi manga platform in October.
author: ANN

title: Higurashi: When They Cry Mahjong Game Gets Remaster for Switch, PS5, PC
content: City Connection announced on Tuesday that the 2009 Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Jong mahjong game for the Higurashi: When They Cry franchise is getting a remaster. The Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Jong Remaster game will launch for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam in Japan in 2027.
author: ANN

title: 24 Years Later, It’s Easier Than Ever to Watch Naruto
content: There’s no denying that even several years after its ending, Masashi Kishimoto’s classic Weekly Shonen Jump series Naruto is still loved among global fans. This beloved manga began serialization in 1999, and not long after, Studio Pierrot’s anime adaptation in 2002 turned it into a global phenomenon.
author: ComicBook
